## 14. Dearness Relief to Pensioners / Family Pensioners  
[ Swamy's FR & SR, Part - IV]  
1. Dearness Relief is granted to compensate for the increase in cost of living, twice in a year, from 1st January and 1st July. From October, 2020, it is based on the price rise beyond the average CPI 261.42, to all pensioners/family pensioners.
2. Admissible on original pension before commutation and also the additional pension/ family pension based on the old age.
